text:
Predicates:
IndoEuropean(x) ::: x is an Indo-European language.
RomanceLanguage(x) ::: x is a Romance language.
LanguageFamily(x) ::: x is a language family.
Within(x, y) ::: x is within y.
Related(x, y) ::: x is related to y.
French ::: the French language.
Spanish ::: the Spanish language.
German ::: the German language.
Basque ::: the Basque language.
Premises:
∀x (RomanceLanguage(x) → IndoEuropean(x)) ::: All Romance languages are Indo-European languages.
RomanceLanguage(French) ∧ RomanceLanguage(Spanish) ::: French and Spanish are both Romance languages.
Related(German, Spanish) ::: German is related to Spanish.
¬Related(Basque, y) ::: Basque is not related to any other language.
Conclusion:
IndoEuropean(French) ::: French is an Indo-European language.
